_readme: Panel definitions. kind=draw: seeded weighted sampling without replacement, one persona per slot from the listed pools (draw_weight in personas.json). kind=fixed: listed members. kind=all: every reviewer persona. Use 'realistic' to estimate what a real draw would do; use the fixed panels to stress specific failure modes. Keep the panel fixed across the rounds of one session.

realistic.description: A typical CVPR assignment: one subfield-matched reviewer, one matched or adjacent, one from anywhere.

realistic4.description: Four-reviewer assignment (common for borderline or emergency-reviewed papers).

quick.description: Cheap first look: skimming senior, subfield expert, adjacent generalist.

stress.description: Hardest realistic panel: novelty skeptic, subfield expert, methodologist, hostile reviewer.

writing.description: Prose and story: clarity editor, adjacent generalist, busy senior, champion.

core.description: Balanced seven covering results, novelty, expertise, rigor, clarity, skimming and hostility.

gauntlet.description: Every persona. Expensive; use before submission.
